title: Ethiopian Lentil Curry
community: Urban Ethiopia — the curry-format lentil dish
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Lentil Curry — red lentils cooked with an Ethiopian-spiced curry sauce of berbere, turmeric, cardamom, and coriander with tomato and onion. The curry format applied to Ethiopian lentils — the berbere anchors it firmly in Ethiopian territory.
longDesc: Ethiopian lentil curry represents the modern urban synthesis of the curry format with the berbere tradition — accessible to those who know curry but unmistakably Ethiopian in character.
steps: Cook onions until very golden — 10 minutes.
Add garlic, ginger, berbere, turmeric, coriander, and cardamom. Stir 2 minutes.
Add lentils and water. Bring to a boil.
chefTips: The berbere gives it an unmistakably Ethiopian character.
cookingScience: See ETH101 for red lentil science.
sustainabilityTips: Lentils are the most sustainable protein source available.
culturalNote: Ethiopian lentil curry demonstrates how Ethiopian food absorbs external influences while retaining its essential identity — the berbere makes it unmistakably Ethiopian regardless of the curry format.
